construction.entry: Actual reader file open and SVG component Canvas render, compared with same-engine original native SVG pixels.
construction.capabilityProbe: 8 Canvas ellipse dash lengths with 3 hit-test positions each; diagnostic only, not a production fingerprint.

findings: Chrome original-component failures remain 16/60: 13 curved cases and 3 malformed pathLength attributes. The rewritten numeric SVG is a separate reference and differs from 19 original Chrome images.

Firefox original-component failures are 11/60. All 3 malformed pathLength controls match the reader; their prior Chrome differences are browser interoperability cases, not dual-reference-certified defects.
Firefox circle/ellipse pathLength rendering differs strongly with the existing Skia-style rational-arc ruler. The same ruler improves Chrome. A blanket replacement is not justified.
Original-native SVG and rewritten numeric SVG must remain separate: getTotalLength does not reliably reproduce the internal paint ruler.

Firefox reports 180 for the collinear reversing cubic, while Chrome reports about 203.819458. Preserve independent analytical cusp evidence rather than treating either browser as an unconditional oracle.
